name: Victoria
source:
Both smart and focused, she's also the caring and bright president of the literature club, a position she has been occupying since her first eligible year. The daughter of a famous journalist, she's following the footsteps of her dad, as she has already written a few articles for a local newspaper. She's proficient at portraying reality in her own manner, but she's not very fond of fiction. 

[From [url=https://twitter.com/innocenceversus/status/1035547976226271233] Twitter[/url]]
